title: Brain assets: the binary files behind the brain view (D28)
about: Stored in the brain_assets table (web/db/migrations/0001_brain_assets.sql), gzip at rest (gzip level 9, mtime 0, so the same input gives the same bytes), served with Content-Encoding: gzip. Every file is little-endian: a fixed 16-byte header (a 4-byte ASCII magic, then three u32) and arrays, no text. What the arrays mean lives in the schema-checked brain page (strategist/hosted_schema/brain.schema.json): its frames, mesh and atlas blocks name each key with the sha256 of the stored gzip bytes and the decompressed length. strategist/brain_assets.py builds and checks them; strategist/db.py and the web read this file for the key format, the sizes and the layouts.

frames.about: One row per second, row-major; vertices 0-10241 left, 10242-20483 right (TRIBE v2 output order). value = q / levels * scale.vmax from the brain page, one scale for the whole reel; q = clip(rint(x / vmax * 127), -127, 127), so -128 never appears and about 1% of cortex values sit at the ends. Unsmoothed 1-s model rows. Medial-wall vertices are encoded too: grey them through the atlas lookup (hcp 0).

mesh.about: fsaverage5 inflated surface and sulcal depth (stored in the private database only; licence unverified, see LICENSES/CREDITS.md section 4). Each side is centred near x = 0 (about +/-41): place the two sides apart along x. Face indices are local to their side (0-10241); faces are wound so the cross product points outward. sulc > 0 is deeper (darker grey).

atlas.about: Per vertex: hcp 0 = medial wall, k = 1..180 = the k-th code in the brain page's atlas.hcp.labels (the same code on both sides); yeo 0 = medial wall, k = 1..7 = atlas.yeo.labels[k - 1]. Built by scoring/build_atlas.py (atlas-v1).
